ownerRequest: Settings parent for Billing/Privacy; useful shop settings, global reusable methods, storefront setup guidance, staged product configuration, visuals and loading skeletons. Legacy is visual reference only.
changes: Shopify sidebar has Products, Orders and Settings. Settings sections are General, Decoration methods, Storefront setup, Billing and Privacy. Historical Billing/Privacy paths redirect privately while preserving the launch query.

Product configuration defaults to four stages: product rules, images/print areas, prices and review/publish. Unsaved state and live preview remain mounted; Back/Continue, browser history, anchors and explicit View all settings preserve editing state. Navigation never saves/publishes.

Authenticated shop method library supports bounded names, up to100 templates, create/rename/remove with optimistic versions and deduplicated commands. Import creates a fresh product-local method ID/name; no prices, geometry, placements or live template reference is inherited. Existing drafts/revisions/orders remain unchanged.

Storefront setup explains configuration publication, app-block placement/button text, cart-repair embed and explicit Shopify Save. Links use actual customize/cart-repair handles and validated public app/shop identifiers; guidance never reads/mutates theme or asserts enabled state.

Accessible skeletons reserve content space for initial product/configuration/order/artwork/billing/privacy/library loads. Reduced-motion preference suppresses animation. New merchant islands are included in the Polaris native-control CI guard.
